title: Audit log
description: An append-only record of the writes made through the CMS — what happened, when, and where it can be traced from. It is the first place to look when a piece of content changed and nobody remembers doing it. Each entry shows whatever the service recorded with it: some carry the account behind the change and the record it touched, some carry only the event and its timestamp.
refresh_hint: The log keeps growing on the server while this page sits still — nothing is pushed here, so reload it when you want a fresh answer.

list.title: Entries
list.description: Newest first. Older entries are reachable by paging back through the log.
